ops.oldText: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer
ops.newText: Except as provided below, Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer

ops.text: Licensee may assign this Agreement, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: For purposes of this Agreement, any Change of Control (as defined in Section 13.4(a)) shall be governed by the provisions of the section entitled Change Of Control and not the provisions of this Section Subject to the terms of this Section, this Agreement will bind and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and permitted assigns.
ops.newText: Subject to the terms of this Section, this Agreement will bind and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and permitted assigns.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We carved our Affiliate and successor assignments out of the consent gate, added a reasonableness standard and competitor bar on Licensor's own assignment, and removed the automatic termination of the Agreement and our licenses on a Change of Control (the definition is preserved). Our playbook does not accept a blanket bar on our assignment or a Vendor exit triggered by our corporate transactions.
proposal.summary: Carve out Licensee assignment to Affiliates and M&A successors, restrict Licensor assignment (reasonable consent, no competitor), and delete the change-of-control auto-termination.
